question: Which of the following Odissi dancers was honored with the Padma Vibhushan in 2000?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kelucharan Mohapatra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra **was honoured with the** Padma Vibhushan** in **2000 **for his contributions to the field of **Odissi dance.**
 
• He was a renowned** Odissi dancer, choreographer, and guru** who played a key role in popularizing the dance form.
 
• Odissi is a classical Indian dance form that originated in the **eastern state of Odisha.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra** is considered one of the pioneers of **modern Odissi dance** and is credited with introducing new elements to the traditional form.
 
• **Madhavi Mudgal** has also worked extensively to promote** Odissi dance** and has collaborated with artists from different parts of the world.
 
• **Sanjukta Panigrahi** was known for her graceful movements and **expressive storytelling** through dance.
 
 
• She was posthumously awarded the **Padma Vibhushan in 2004.**
 
 
 
• **Priyambada Mohanty Hejmadi** is a noted **Odissi dancer and teacher** who has trained under **Kelucharan Mohapatra.**
